los-angeles-angeles-crest-high-road.title: Los Angeles · Angeles Crest High Road
los-angeles-angeles-crest-high-road.slogan: A 164 km loop out of La Cañada
los-angeles-angeles-crest-high-road.story: Elevation, sweepers and closure discipline north of LA. Out of La Cañada Flintridge and back again: 164 km, roughly 3 h 09 in the saddle. The stops in between: Newcomb’s Ranch area and Wrightwood mountain edge. The climb of the day is Angeles Crest scenic core. It tops out at about 1,450 m. The passes are the reason to go.

sections.advice: This Angeles Crest scenic core → Newcomb’s Ranch area stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

sections.advice: Newcomb’s Ranch area → Wrightwood mountain edge is the reward section in San Francisco. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
